SM_SF_FreshBrokenStump.description: Newly broken standing trunk; pale ragged heartwood, long sharp wood fibres, radiating roots.

SM_SF_FreshFallenTree.description: Fresh matching fallen trunk along +X; pale splintered break at -X, intact layered green crown at +X.

SM_SF_OldMossLog.description: Old hollow fallen log along +X; open dark passage, eroded thick rims, fissures, moss cushions and shelf fungi.
